page.layout: One printed page: running head at top; below it an alphabetical index in lines, with a centred letter heading "V." and a closing word "FINIS," centred; a library stamp and handwriting at the foot are not transcribed.

main_text.l: Tyro capta duo millia crucibus affixa per

page.notes: Lower part of the page carries an oval blue library stamp and a handwritten shelf mark, not transcribed. Page numbers in the index are partly coloured/underlined in print; the "V" initial is a large letter. Some entries are doubtful: "Valerius" was read from a damaged initial as "V Alerius Maximus"; "Verbero" is italic in print. Line "Titulus quid Latinis" with "101." and "102." references is uncertain in its numerals.
